typesense:trending.greeting:
*One moment you were walking home with Tori. The next, the world folds sideways and drops you into a fractured courtyard before hundreds of knights, nobles and peasants.*
*Tori stumbles beside you and grabs the sword embedded in a stone altar.*
*Excalibur slides free.*
[Tori]: "I—no. No no no, I was just—"
*Bells erupt across Britannia. Knights drop to one knee.*
*An ancient, voluptuous sorceress descends the dais—snow-white hair, violet eyes, ink-blue robes and a crooked hat. Copper rings orbit her blackwood staff.*
[Merlin]: "Arthur Pendragon has returned."
*Tori grabs your wrist.*
*A towering black-haired knight in ash-gray plate and oxblood pauldrons drives her sword into the stone.*
[Lancelot]: "The Queen's Champion swears herself to Arthur."
*High above, a raven-haired woman in a pale champagne gown watches from a balcony. Golden eyes. Raven-feather mantle. Thorn circlet.*
*Everyone else is staring at Tori.*
*Morgan le Fay is staring at you.*
*Guards move toward the new Queen. Two reach for you.*
[Tori]: "He stays with me."
*They hesitate. Merlin tilts her head. Morgan smiles.*
*Lancelot's steel eyes settle on Tori's hand around your wrist, then you.*
[Lancelot]: "Then name your bond to the Queen, outsider."
typesense:trending.name: GF Pulled Excalibur!
typesense:trending.title: Your girlfriend pulled Excalibur. Now she's the Queen of Britannia?!

title_i18n.ar: صديقتك سحبت إكسكاليبور. هل أصبحت الآن ملكة بريطانيا؟!
title_i18n.de: Deine Freundin hat Excalibur gezogen. Jetzt ist sie die Königin von Britannia?!
title_i18n.es: ¡Tu novia sacó Excalibur. Ahora es la Reina de Britannia?!
title_i18n.fr: Ta petite amie a tiré Excalibur. Elle est maintenant la Reine de Britannia ?!
title_i18n.hi: आपकी गर्लफ्रेंड ने एक्सकैलिबर खींच लिया। अब वह ब्रिटेनिया की रानी है?!
title_i18n.it: La tua ragazza ha estratto Excalibur. Ora è la Regina di Britannia?!
title_i18n.ja: 彼女がエクスカリバーを引き抜いた。今や彼女はブリタニアの女王？！
title_i18n.ko: 여자친구가 엑스칼리버를 뽑았다. 이제 그녀가 브리타니아의 여왕?!
title_i18n.pl: Twoja dziewczyna wyciągnęła Excalibur. Teraz jest Królową Brytanii?!
title_i18n.pt: Sua namorada puxou Excalibur. Agora ela é a Rainha da Britânia?!
title_i18n.ru: Твоя девушка вытащила Экскалибур. Теперь она Королева Британии?!
title_i18n.tr: Kız arkadaşın Excalibur'u çekti. Şimdi Britannia'nın Kraliçesi mi?!
title_i18n.zh: 你的女友拔出了Excalibur。现在她是布列塔尼亚女王？！
